hypothesis: US equity-index returns concentrate around the turn of the calendar month.

rule.entry: close of the second-to-last trading session of each month
rule.exit: close of the third trading session of the following month

economics.note: Capital-independent return screen; sizing is downstream only. Raw unadjusted CFD closes make omitted distributions conservative.

evidence: McConnell and Xu (2008), Equity Returns at the Turn of the Month, Financial Analysts Journal 64(2)
Recent literature is mixed and reports decay of calendar anomalies; therefore 2024 stays sealed until development passes.
